maddeler.e:
اكتفيت (form VIII)
# اِكْتَفَيْتُ (iktafaytu) /ik.ta.faj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
# اِكْتَفَيْتَ (iktafayta) /ik.ta.faj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
# اِكْتَفَيْتِ (iktafayti) /ik.ta.faj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
# اُكْتُفِيتُ (uktufītu) /uk.tu.fiː.tu/: first-person singular
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
